import pe_deal_graph.queries  # noqa: F401  (loads core, rules and graphs)
from pe_deal_graph.model.core import model, Person, Role, Organization, Knows
from relationalai.semantics.std import strings

# Roles held by Tom Harlowe or Victor Hale at Varnell Lab Services
roles = model.where(
    Role.person(Person),
    Role.organization(Organization),
    Person.name.in_(["Tom Harlowe", "Victor Hale"]),
    strings.contains(Organization.name, "Varnell"),
).select(

).to_df()

    b.name.in_(["Tom Harlowe", "Victor Hale"]),
).select(
    a.name.alias("p1"), b.name.alias("p2"),
    Knows.strength.alias("strength"), Knows.evidence.alias("evidence"),
).to_df()
print("\nKnows ties between them:", len(ties))
print(ties.to_string(index=False))
